matches.rationale: No finding addresses the equation (3) decomposition, concatenation notation, or index mismatch between unimodal/cross-modal update terms.

The finding identifies exactly the same mathematical issue: sqrt(N_t) scaling (token length) is used instead of sqrt(d) (feature dimension), and notes the inconsistency between the main-text (sqrt(d)) and appendix (sqrt(N_t)) versions of the same attention formula — matching the ground truth's core complaint about misapplied scaling factor.
No finding discusses the B*0 vs plain 0 inconsistency in equation (13)'s cross-modal adaptation term for text tokens.
